metadata.title: A call to action: a systematic review of ethical and regulatory issues in using process data in educational assessment

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level large-scale assessment datasets and thus does not handle plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data and therefore does not apply sampling weights.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any validation strategies, as it is a systematic review and does not conduct empirical analysis.
